_doc: GAS-STATION-LIFT-01: bought Cosmos props in the Caliche gas station's shop (S47StationDressing; the meshes by Tools/cosmosshop, git-ignored under /Game/Licensed/CosmosShop, loaded only if present). at: the town metres (x, y up, z; the shop's interior_layout.json) where the bottom centre of the piece's turned and scaled bounds goes; origin_town: the station model's origin there (its placement.json town). yaw, pitch, roll: Unreal degrees in the model's frame (yaw 0: the mesh's +X to town +x, yaw 90: to town +z, the back wall). anchor_of: place by another piece's bounds (the drawer with its register). collide: a walk block from its bounds. model (PROPS-REUSE-20261113): a shared model by its id in catalogue.json instead of an asset path; the Cosmos pieces face their mesh +Y (the fridge at yaw -90 looks into the shop from the west wall), so yaw 180 turns a front to the shop from the back wall (the coffee machine on the back cabinet: yaw 0 had its front to the wall) and yaw -90 to +x (the night chair at the desk under the window). standin: the old low-poly piece the model replaces, as a part of the station model of its own (gs_interior.py: Brewer, NightChair), shown only while the model is not here; wait_for_standin: the model waits until that part exists (until a new Blender build the stand-in is baked into gas_station_Station and the two would overlap). Not read by S47Props.
